text:
maya: Quick thought — for audit exports triggered from Console, do we surface actor context (who clicked export) in the console notification payload or keep notifications minimal and require download to see details?
ethan: leaning toward minimal in notif. Presigned links can be opened by different people, might leak actor identity in email/SMS.
priya: but product asked for quick triage — knowing who requested export in the UI notification speeds response for compliance ops.
jordi: can we compromise? include a tenant-scoped actor handle (non-PII) in notif, full actor details only inside the presigned bundle and the secure download page.
maya: how would that affect telemetry? we need consistent events to show "who requested" in audit dashboard without storing PII in notif channel.
priya: telemetry events we emit should be fine: export.requested (actor_hash, tenant_id, export_id) and export.notification_sent (export_id, channel). actor_hash is okay for dashboards.
ethan: agree on actor_hash for analytics, but product wants display name in Console toast. maybe show a contextual label like "Requested by a team member" and on hover show exact name only to users with view-audit entitlement.
jordi: entitlement gating is key. also need to consider quota impacts — big customers trigger monthly bulk exports. we should rate-limit notifications to ops channel to avoid spam.
maya: note: exports are priced per-event and per-GB. we also need server-side throttling: export.queue_size cap + per-tenant concurrent exports. current config: 
```
export.queue_max=100
export.concurrent_per_tenant=2
export.presign_expiry=3600
```
we may want burst tokens for enterprise customers.
ethan: can we also add a console-level knob to control notif detail? e.g., Console > Audit > Export notifications: Minimal / Contextual / Full (requires entitlement).
priya: +1. Defaults to Contextual. Admins can change. Document in UX about redaction defaults.
jordi: privacy/legal: if notification contains actor display name, it's in email body and might be archived externally. legal prefers hashed actor in notifications.
maya: then plan: notif includes actor_label ("Team member", "Admin", or hashed alias) and a link to console download page which requires login + entitlement for full actor info. telemetry keeps actor_hash for reporting.
priya: implementation checklist: 
- API: include actor_label, export_id, tenant_id in /exports POST response
- Notification service: send templated notif with actor_label only
- Console: when opening download modal, if user has entitlement call /exports/:id/details to show who requested
- Telemetry: emit export.requested (actor_hash) and export.downloaded (actor_hash if downloader has entitlement)

ethan: API shape suggestion for /exports POST response: 
```json
{
  "export_id": "e-1234",
  "status": "queued",
  "actor_label": "Team member",
  "presign_url": "https://s3...",
  "presign_expires_at": "2024-11-05T14:03:00Z"
}
```
jordi: don't return presign_url in the initial response for non-privileged clients. Return a download_token and fetch presign only after entitlement check.
maya: good point. default flow: POST -> queued -> notification -> user clicks link -> entitlement check -> get presign -> download.
audit-bot: SYSTEM: export.requested emitted (export_id=e-1234, actor_hash=hs_9f, tenant_id=t-555, queue_pos=12) :white_check_mark:
priya: UX question: should we show a tiny preview count (filesize estimate, event count) in notif? helpful but might leak counts.
ethan: show "~N events" rounded buckets ("~1k events") to avoid exact exposure.
maya: rounding buckets + no exact sizes is fine. Add console setting for admins to include exact numbers only for internal channels.
jordi: how are we handling retries and failed export telemetry? we need export.failed with failure_reason and export.retry_count. that affects SLA dashboards.
priya: also capture who cancelled an export (actor_hash) and emit export.cancelled. console should allow cancel button if queued.
maya: final action items:
- @ethan update export API to return actor_label + download_token (not presign) (ETA: 2d)
- @jordi add quota enforcement + burst tokens + telemetry hooks (ETA: 3d)
- @priya write UX copy and admin toggle for notif detail (ETA: 1d)
- @maya coordinate small canary rollout to 10% tenants for 1 week, monitor export.requested/completed error-rate and notif_spam metric (ETA: next sprint)
priya: I'll draft notification copy and send for legal review.
ethan: I'll prototype entitlement check endpoint.
jordi: I'll add telemetry events to the export worker and wire up quota metrics.
maya: thanks — we'll reconvene after the canary. :white_check_mark:
